blocks.text: Introducing Furinno Just 3-Tier Turn-N-Tube Open Storage Nightstand that is crafted for the modern home, this elegant piece comes with various finishes that effortlessly blend with diverse bedroom themes. With three spacious tiers, it's perfect for storing your nightly essentials, from books to bedside lamps. This series is made of CARB Grade composite wood and manufactured in Malaysia. It is durable and constructed with stable material and has no foul smell. A simple attitude towards lifestyle is reflected directly in the design of Furinno Furniture, creating a trend of simply nature. Assembly is easy with provided step-by-step instructions. Care instructions: wipe clean with a clean dry cloth. Avoid using harsh chemicals. Pictures are for illustration purposes. All decor items are not included in this offer. The product is entitled to a 1-year warranty against manufacturer defects. Fits Space, Fits Budget.

items.label: SIMPLE & MODERN DESIGN
items.value: This night stand features a 3-tier open shelf layout with a clean look that suits bedrooms, living rooms, or dorms

items.label: 3-TIER OPEN STORAGE
items.value: The Nightstand provides three levels of storage space for lamps, books, alarm clocks, or storage bins, keeping essentials within easy reach

items.label: WEIGHT CAPACITY
items.value: Each level of this bedside table/end table holds up to 20 lbs (9 kg); total unit supports up to 60 lbs (27.2 kg)

items.label: STURDY BUILT
items.value: Crafted from high-quality, durable composite wood with rounded corner to prevent injuries and reinforced PVC tubes. Built with FSC-certified wood, it unites sustainable materials and refined craftsmanship to deliver long-term durability and reliable use
